question: What do Essential PH-1 owners report about getting help from customer support?
answer:
One reviewer described Essential's customer support as nonexistent and quite rude, saying they were told to look on the internet for help. [6587372921a0_0]
Another reviewer reported that customer support is via email only and that the team takes up to four business days to respond. [03e9d3f323d6_0]
A reviewer who dealt with Essential's customer service for two months called the staff friendly but seemingly unable to solve a serious issue in a reasonable manner. [595148663e4a_1]
One owner described customer support as horrendous, unresponsive, and dismissive, guessing the company was understaffed for RMAs. [f0a82b824f5e_0]
Another reviewer said the Essential customer service team was courteous but unhelpful. [10e939d8bb10_0]
In contrast, one reviewer said Essential was super helpful right away and called the support outstanding. [05d17d345ba8_3]

chunks.text: Buyer Beware! Customer support is nonexistent and quite rude. Phone is useless within 6 months. It became corrupted within 6 months of normal use and support did not help me I was told to look on the internet for help (like really?). I did try different things that I found online and even reset the device to no avail. I had to change most of my sensitive passwords multiple times because I was getting emails and texts for 2 factor authentication that I did not initiate. This phone is next to useless and they do not stand behind it at all. I basically wasted hundreds of dollars and was told that I must have done something to void the warranty (which I didn't). I am never buying an Essential Product again. I've had better support from phones from Chinese companies. This product was a total flop for a reason.

Decent phone, poor camera, the worst customer service possible.. This phone is a great size and feels very high quality. The camera is quite horrible, and my phone failed 11 months after I bought it. Customer support is via email only and it's been 2 weeks and I don't even have a order in for a replacement phone or been told how to send it back. The customer service team takes up to 4 business days to respond to emails so it can take up to a week to send a message, get a reply, and give them the information they seek. I bought this phone in Halo Grey, and spent more money to do it, their replacement phone is going to be black or white and they've told me tough luck that's what we've got when I asked for what else they can do since they couldn't replace like for like.

The replacement phone was a refurbished unit and had problems with making and receiving calls from the beginning. I have dealt with Essential's customer service for two months trying to get this resolved, cooperating fully with the requests from the customer service and technical support people to reset, change settings, turn on, turn off, etc. I was notified a few days ago that technical support has had other customers with the same problem and that they would see if my phone would be replaced under warranty. They will possibly send me another refurbished phone, similar to the one that didn't work... Basically, I've had my "Essential Phone" for 10 weeks, and it has worked less than 25% of the time. Customer Service is friendly, but seems unable to solve a serious issue in a reasonable manner (we've done a lot of running in circles).

Do not support a company that won't support their customers.. God awful customer support. Initial impressions were great feel, terribly executed software (very buggy plenty of touchscreen issues, poor memory optimization etc.) We develop mobile applications and firebase shows a crazy skew in crashes on this device (despite having hardly any users on this device). This device is not built to last. Screen began lifting out of the frame, looks like some cheap adhesive (that's why no water resistant certification). This causes light leak on the front facing camera (minor issue) but the lifting screen and gap are a big problem after just a couple months of light use. Customer support had been horrendous - unresponsive, dismissive. Guess they're understaffed and ill equipped to deal with RMAs. What a shame was really rooting for these guys. Shoddy.

No support 1 year after purchase (limited 12mo warranty). I was pretty happy with the phone itself - it is a very well designed stock Android phone with OTA updates rolling out very quickly. On the basis of product experience and functionality, would give 5 stars. However, having experienced software/hardware (unsure) issue with the phone that I could not figure out how to solve, the support from the Essential customer service team was courteous, but unhelpful, leaving me with a nice looking brick and in need of a new phone less than 18 months from purchase. The gist of the experienced issue is that phone has shut off after full battery discharge (continuous videoconferencing). After battery was recharged, phone appears to have turned on, but the screen would not, making the phone unusable. After attempting to find a solution on XDA/Reddit on my own, I contacted Essential customer support via chat describing the issue.

Customer support is by email only, and with the issues that arise now and again, it is annoying not to be able to speak with anyone. A gorgeous screen, solid hardware, but it just doesn't do what a top of the line phone should do. I haven't traded out of it yet, but will likely soon.

The Amazon rep assured me that I was incorrect, and even if I was correct, he would not have the authority to help me. When I asked to speak to a manager, the rep told me that the manager is unavailable, and that the manager would just tell me exactly what that rep was telling me. I have been calling Amazon via telephone every few days, hoping to speak to a real person who is State-side and has the authority to actually help, but it's been months, and no luck. So now I am out of both the phone and partial refund. I am disgusted with both Essential company and Amazon customer service. Amazon used to have great customer service too. Not anymore. I would give a zero for how fragile the phone was and another zero for the customer service from both Essential and Amazon.

Never buy - Worst quality and customer support experience. Within 3months of usage, essential pushed new software upgrade after that the phone refused to function screen went unresponsive then support people kept asking me layers of questions to wear me off. Once the device is the warranty they refuse to support any more. This is the worst customer experience I have ever experienced

Prone to failure and no support or warranty.. I've had 3 of these for about 15 months. One bricked when upgrading to Android P, One had it's fingerprint reader fail after 9 months, and One had it's proximity detector fail ( screen won't turn off when placed next to your face.) For the one that bricked, it took a while to contact Essential customer service, they have no telephone support only email. Even Sprint could not reach them! The replacement phone they sent was CDMA only, the original was CDMA/GSM, so when I switch to AT&T, That phone was useless and since I had Sprint unlock it it's now blacklisted and basically trash. I tried to contact Essential but now no one responds to email anymore. Well there was $500 down the drain. No warranty on any of the 3 phones since no one responds to email and they have no phone or chat help.

I REALLY wanted to love this phone and I do really appreciate the customer support. The U11 guys never responded when I tried to get it fixed. Essential was super helpful right away! That alone is reason to try them again and if they get the hardware right I certainly will. I'm between 2 and 3 stars on this guy: minus 1 for software and minus 2 for hardware but the support was outstanding and I'm going to give this a solid 3. I'm looking forward to a PH-2 review of 5 starts!
